name: unipi
description: Every ported unipi package driven live in Oino Desktop with a real model (oino/deepseek/deepseek-flash): each command, tool, dialog and panel from design.md §7, asserted through the automation tree, `state.chrome` and `state.open`.

scenarios.covers: hint strip, alt+h cycling, /hint browser, work tray (↓)
/info dashboard tabs (session/usage/tools/skills/modules), r refresh, close
glance frame + stats segments, /footer off/on
mode chip + menu, /permission ask, approval card allow, /plan on/off
ask_user tool (enabled by settings), question card, answer, turn resumes
/goal run + status, /visualize-progress, /regular clears the mode, ralph/graph/swarm help
/memory status card, /memory-search, /global-memory-list, memory_store tool, /memory-consolidate dialog
/dream status/report/approve/reject/tray
/skills settings page, exposure switch, /hint cross-link
/agents profile dialog, /subagents tray tab, run_subagent row + result
AgentRow live status, Agent tab child timeline, Stop agent (demo fixtures)
/bg task + tray strip, /bg-tasks stop all, bg_run + completion notification
/btw side-chat panel answer, close
web_search tool row, /info Web tab
/mcp-status panel, settings hub MCP namespace
/notify-event list + toggle, settings hub Notify namespace
native Board page, FAB new task, /kanboard status, /kanboard-add
'/' completion menu with package tags, filtering
/compact-stats, /compact-doctor, /session-recall, /compact-vcc, /compact-by-llm summary, /compact-help
/readme panel, /changelog panel, Settings About & updates
alt+h, alt+m mode menu, alt+p plan toggle, completion of /ho
/fusion picker + filter + pick, /fusion-stats
/bg-detach adopts a running bash call, tray shows it
/app control-centre side tab, its four tabs, hide
/doctor, /cleanup, /move, /answer, settings hub
image attachment through the composer (utility attachments + image tool path)
/cron status, Automations page, new-job dialog
/browser command, browser_open tool row
